description: Machine-readable ownership catalog for Supabase RPC call-site groups. It covers literal .rpc("...") runtime/script call sites by pattern; per-RPC migration introspection comes in a later wave.

groups.name: customer-diagnostic-history
groups.authMode: managed service role or direct owner transaction lane; verified customer attribution at ingest; active operator checked for reads
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Atomic bounded diagnostic admission and append; immutable identity segments; v1 reads preserve the retained v1-only shape while v2 reads retain stored per-event coverage. The v2 overview returns bounded identifier-free groups with separately classified example segments. Every read and retained access audit are one transaction. No browser table or RPC access.
groups.idempotency: Segment-scoped event replay deduplicates only identical payloads including coverage version; conflicting payloads fail without overwrite.
groups.rollback: Disable diagnostic controls; bounded prune removes expired diagnostic rows only. Business records are unaffected.

groups.name: checkout-payment-guidance-read
groups.authMode: service-role adapter; BFF validates exact checkout continuation or existing recovery token
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Read-only consistent checkout state and bounded correlated refusal evidence; no browser grants, provider reads or settlement.
groups.idempotency: No writes. Recovery token liveness is rechecked in the same statement snapshot.
groups.rollback: Omit optional guidance; retain legacy status fallback and additive read function. Schema activation requires separate rollout.

groups.name: admin-communications-email-template-slugs-read
groups.authMode: administrator session at the BFF plus service-role managed adapter
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Read-only complete distinct non-empty template slugs for the admin email console; no direct browser execution.
groups.idempotency: Read-only stable projection; adapter preserves JavaScript sorting.
groups.rollback: Restore the previous adapter read before separately retiring this additive read-only routine; no data rollback is needed.

groups.name: admin-communications-email-statistics-read
groups.authMode: administrator session at the BFF plus service-role managed adapter
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Read-only global exact counters for the admin email console; browser clients do not call the routine directly.
groups.idempotency: Read-only stable projection of the current send and event rows.
groups.rollback: Restore the adapter's four legacy count reads; the additive routine writes no rows and can remain until separate retirement.

groups.name: admin-clients-search-read
groups.authMode: admin session at the BFF plus service-role managed adapter
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Read-only bounded physical-customer search. Ranking, count and pagination execute in one RPC; acquisition records stay outside the client registry and browser clients never call the routine directly.
groups.idempotency: Read-only deterministic projection of query, page, page size and lifecycle filter.
groups.rollback: Revert the adapter and drop admin_clients_search_v3 plus its bounded trigram indexes; no business row is written by the routine.

groups.name: personalization-declension-enqueue
groups.authMode: service-role through the personalization port (configurator persist-intent path)
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The personalization domain enqueues the async declension outbox job; browser clients never call this RPC directly. It only inserts into public.outbox_events (idempotent), never customer-facing state.
groups.idempotency: outbox unique (event_type, idempotency_key) = client id + input hash; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
groups.rollback: Disable COMMERCE_PERSONALIZATION_DECLENSION_ENABLED; the RPC is service-role only and produces no customer-visible effect while off.

groups.name: risk-review-control-plane
groups.authMode: service-role through the risk domain ports (admin BFF + order-paid assessment)
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Risk domain owns assessment/case/blocklist writes; browser clients and other domains never call risk RPCs directly.
groups.idempotency: risk idempotency key, order id, payment event id, and one-open-case-per-order uniqueness
groups.rollback: Disable the COMMERCE_RISK_* flags; risk RPCs are service-role only and produce no customer-visible effect while off.

groups.name: accounting-invoice-and-provider-ledger
groups.authMode: service-role through accounting domain ports
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Accounting domain writes invoice/provider ledger state; BFF and jobs do not call provider RPCs directly.
groups.idempotency: invoice/order/provider refs and request idempotency keys
groups.rollback: Disable accounting mutation/provider flags and replay or fail outbox rows from the accounting runbook.

groups.name: commerce-checkout-runtime
groups.authMode: service-role through commerce BFF/domain ports or hidden-preview smoke
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Commerce runtime owns checkout/order draft writes; browser clients never call these RPCs directly.
groups.idempotency: checkout idempotency key, order id, payment event id, or preview fixture key
groups.rollback: Disable checkout/payment/reservation flags and use checkout cleanup/release probes.

groups.name: commerce-promotion-quote-read-v2
groups.authMode: service-role through the commerce promotion quote port
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Read-only, advisory candidate resolution. The v2 response adds only UI-safe rejection details; browser clients never call the RPC directly and canonical order money/claiming remain unchanged.
groups.idempotency: Stable read-only projection for an explicit quote input and time
groups.rollback: The port falls back to the existing v1 RPC only for PGRST202/undefined-function during staged migration rollout; all other errors fail closed.

groups.name: commerce-offer-policy-readiness
groups.authMode: service-role through the commerce offer-policy readiness port
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Read-only aggregate readiness. It exposes no customer identifiers or PII and browser clients cannot execute it.
groups.idempotency: Stable read-only projection with no writes
groups.rollback: Set COMMERCE_OFFER_POLICY_V2_ROLLOUT_BPS=0 or disable COMMERCE_OFFER_POLICY_V2_ENABLED; existing signed assignments remain honor-only.

groups.name: commerce-offer-policy-legacy-baseline
groups.authMode: explicit service-role operator capture after audited environment readback
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Insert-once aggregate baseline only; never mutates customer/subscription rows, never exposes raw IDs, and never overwrites drift.
groups.idempotency: First audited capture wins; subsequent calls return the existing immutable baseline
groups.rollback: Keep the aggregate audit row; disable assignment rollout. Baseline replacement requires a separately reviewed migration.

groups.name: commerce-fulfillment-ledger
groups.authMode: service-role through commerce/fulfillment ports
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Fulfillment/order handoff and durable provider-command state are owned by domain ports; provider infra must not own local ledger, claim, fencing, or retry semantics.
groups.idempotency: fulfillment order id, immutable command fingerprints, idempotency key, claim token, and monotonic claim generation
groups.rollback: Disable fulfillment dispatch flags and replay or fail paid-order outbox rows.

groups.name: fulfillment-provider-stock-authority
groups.authMode: service-role through fulfillment provider stock-sync ports
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Fulfillment writes provider-current stock projections; inventory consumes the projection only through provider-aware reservation RPCs.
groups.idempotency: provider kind, provider SKU, sync run id, and stock-sync idempotency key
groups.rollback: Disable provider stock sync and force provider stock authority back to local ATP through the fulfillment provider capability flag.

groups.name: commerce-oms-admin
groups.authMode: admin session plus service-role BFF/domain port
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Admin BFF/domain writes; read model remains commerce-owned.
groups.idempotency: admin actor, order/hold id, and action idempotency key
groups.rollback: Disable OMS mutation flags and preserve existing queue reads.

groups.name: payment-control-and-method-refs
groups.authMode: service-role through payment/commerce domain ports and verified webhooks
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Payment domain ingests provider events, claims stale provider attempts for read-only reconciliation, and applies terminal results only through payment-control; the distinct interactive prepared-attempt reopen RPC is service-role-only and accepts only trusted no-dispatch facts or exact-attempt operator/watchdog absence proof. It terminalizes local attempt/intent/payment without dunning, renewal scheduling, subscription mutation, or reservation release; provider adapters return sanitized outcomes.
groups.idempotency: provider event id, payment intent id, attempt id, and idempotency key; interactive reopen additionally fingerprints every expected aggregate id plus the bounded evidence mode/phase/code
groups.rollback: Disable provider payment flags and keep payment-control replay/read-only paths available.

groups.name: communications-consent-email-ledger
groups.authMode: service-role through communications domain ports or signed provider webhooks
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Communications domain owns consent, provider event, delivery, and sync outbox writes.
groups.idempotency: contact id, provider event id, send decision id, delivery id, or sync outbox id
groups.rollback: Disable communications sync/webhook flags and replay provider/sync outbox rows.

groups.name: customer-selfservice-preferences
groups.authMode: authenticated customer actor through the direct self-service binding
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The customer self-service runtime owns preference reads and writes; the database derives the principal from the transaction-local actor rather than caller input.
groups.idempotency: principal id plus the requested consent state; unchanged writes preserve the current revision
groups.rollback: Select the managed bundle or disable customer self-service recovery while retaining the inert direct rail.

groups.name: communications-transactional-delivery-receipts
groups.authMode: service-role through the named managed adapter or a capability-local role-free transaction through the named PostgreSQL receipt adapter
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The paired Communications receipt adapters own neutral captured-delivery receipt reads and accepted/failed writes. Browser clients and unrelated runtimes cannot execute these invoker-rights RPCs.
groups.idempotency: bounded idempotency key plus immutable command fingerprint; accepted receipts are terminal and failed receipts may advance to accepted
groups.rollback: Keep the inert receipt relation and RPCs; revert the experimental Node binding. There is no second delivery path to fall back to - the Deno twin went with the Edge tree when it was retired in source on 2026-09-05, so reverting leaves the capability inert, not degraded.

groups.name: inventory-reservation-and-stock
groups.authMode: service-role through commerce/inventory domain ports or hidden-preview smoke
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Inventory reservation and stock writes are owned by inventory/commerce ports; availability counts active reservation leases, not cleanup state.
groups.idempotency: reservation key, order id, stock adjustment id, and TTL
groups.rollback: Disable checkout/runtime flags and release reservations by order id.

groups.name: subscription-runtime-and-dunning
groups.authMode: service-role through subscription cron/domain/payment ports
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Subscription domain owns lifecycle, dunning, renewal, and cycle-order writes.
groups.idempotency: subscription id, cycle id, payment attempt id, and dunning batch id
groups.rollback: Disable subscription mutation/renewal flags and pause cron dispatchers.

groups.name: outbox-runtime
groups.authMode: service-role through commerce outbox ports and preview matrix smoke
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Outbox store owns claim, mark, release, prune, and stats state.
groups.idempotency: outbox event id and handler lease
groups.rollback: Disable outbox dispatch/prune flags and release unprocessed leases.

groups.name: omnipack-evidence
groups.authMode: service-role jobs plus verified provider webhooks
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Fulfillment owns OmniPack dispatch refs, status evidence, stock evidence, and cursors. Executable dispatch uses the service-role-only draft recorder plus omnipack_begin_direct_dispatch_submission(uuid,text) as the locked pre-POST fence; direct table writes are denied. The active acknowledgement path never mutates the retained provider-command ledger. Ambiguous calls stop in uncertain, while accepted provider proof and the existing local label acknowledgement commit atomically.
groups.idempotency: fulfillment advisory mutex, one logical dispatch ref, immutable request fingerprint, two-argument direct draft-to-submitting compare-and-set, separate provider-acceptance and label-ack keys, provider ref, status event id, stock cursor, and replay-safe webhook token
groups.rollback: Disable OmniPack flags and replay or ignore provider evidence from the fulfillment runbook.

groups.name: catalog-sku-eans-packs
groups.authMode: service-role through the fulfillment product-sync port
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The OmniPack product-sync port upserts catalog pack (SKU↔EAN) rows; browser clients never call this RPC, and a openlup/local-owned pack is never overwritten by a pull.
groups.idempotency: (catalog_sku_id, ean) anchor; the RPC returns {conflict, replayed} and re-runs are no-ops
groups.rollback: Disable COMMERCE_OMNIPACK_PRODUCT_SYNC_ENABLED; the packs table is unread by checkout/dispatch.

groups.name: catalog-change-proposal-submit
groups.authMode: admin session at the BFF plus service-role managed adapter
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Append-only evidence inbox. The routine performs the sole INSERT after digest, shape, identity, scope and blocked-publication checks; it creates no revision, pointer, offer or approval, and browser roles hold no EXECUTE.
groups.idempotency: The envelope digest is the natural key; replaying identical bytes returns inserted=false through the three unique constraints rather than writing a second row.
groups.rollback: Revert the adapter and the route; the table is immutable by trigger and holds only blocked, non-publishable evidence.

groups.name: feedback-public-hash
groups.authMode: public hash/recovery token with RPC-level validation
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Feedback domain adapters and BFF routes submit hash-scoped survey state only; tester-program owns participation state, not feedback RPC persistence. Media mutations use the separate service-only family.
groups.idempotency: feedback hash, section key, media hash, and package rating id
groups.rollback: Disable or route feedback upload/action surfaces while preserving read-only page access.

groups.name: feedback-media-service
groups.authMode: validated feedback bearer at the BFF plus service-role adapter; browser database EXECUTE denied
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Confirmation checks delivery, tester key ownership and object existence, then explicitly passes the fixed quota to canonical append-3. Both append overloads deny browser execution. The canonical service-only removal validates bearer/key scope and changes metadata before object deletion. Direct browser mutation is forbidden.
groups.idempotency: exact media key replay does not append or notify twice
groups.rollback: Preserve the service path and browser denial; no automatic privilege restoration or object deletion.

groups.name: platform-admin-oms-preview-fixture-cleanup
groups.authMode: service-role through the run-scoped staging Admin OMS provisioner
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The staging provisioner may remove only its exact synthetic machine-admin fixture and fixture-owned audit rows; direct service-role UPDATE and DELETE on admin_users remain revoked.
groups.idempotency: exact synthetic admin id and matching admin-oms-preview example.invalid email; an already-absent fixture is a no-op
groups.rollback: Stop provisioning the Admin OMS staging fixture; no human membership or retained audit-history path uses this RPC.

groups.name: platform-admin-user-management
groups.authMode: admin session through the platform domain adapter
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Platform admin BFF/domain adapter validates an active administrator before changing roles or atomically revoking current-panel membership. Revocation retains the identity and actor row for historical attribution.
groups.idempotency: admin actor id, target user id, requested role or active-to-revoked state transition, and one audit event
groups.rollback: Disable admin user role/revoke mutation; restore a previous role or reactivate a retained membership through a separately reviewed recovery operation using audit evidence.

groups.name: platform-admin-magic-link-rate-limit
groups.authMode: service-role through admin magic-link BFF
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Platform admin login owns the hashed email/IP attempt ledger; browser clients never call the RPC directly.
groups.idempotency: hashed IP, hashed email, advisory locks, and fixed time window
groups.rollback: Disable the admin magic-link UI/route; password login, invites, and recovery remain available.

groups.name: partners-public-b2b-inquiry-submit
groups.authMode: service-role through the public partners BFF
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The partners submission handler validates the public payload and hashes the caller IP before invoking this service-role-only RPC; browser callers cannot execute it directly.
groups.idempotency: Per-IP transaction advisory lock plus a bounded recent-row quota serializes count-and-insert decisions; denied requests write no inquiry.
groups.rollback: Disable the public B2B inquiry route before removing the RPC; existing inquiry rows remain readable by admin workflows.

groups.name: marketing-notification-cron
groups.authMode: cron secret, customer request, or service-role domain port
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Marketing/commerce notification ports enqueue or close notification work; the versioned abandoned-cart RPC binds production work to its runtime Supabase URL before it invokes the existing producer. Provider send is separate.
groups.idempotency: notification id, contact id, product id, and enqueue batch
groups.rollback: Disable marketing/outbox dispatch flags and stop cron invocation.

groups.name: admin-promotion-codes
groups.authMode: admin session plus service-role promotion-code domain port
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Promotion-code reads and writes stay behind typed admin handlers; mutations combine idempotency, data and audit in one transaction.
groups.idempotency: admin actor, UUID idempotency key and server request fingerprint
groups.rollback: No rollout flag remains (retired in PR 2243): pause or archive the affected codes in the Code Center, then revert and re-release if the defect is code-level.

groups.name: admin-catalog-audit
groups.authMode: admin session plus service-role domain port
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Admin promotion mutations must record audit events. Legacy admin_set_catalog_price and admin_set_subscription_band_percent retain their signatures but are fenced with SQLSTATE 42501 legacy_catalog_mutation_fenced; D2 publication and EAN ingestion are separate legal writers. Wave 7a: the domain-neutral agent customer-read guard (server/_lib/admin-domain) audits machine customer reads through the same frozen primitive.
groups.idempotency: admin actor, target id, and audit event key; fenced catalog writers never mutate
groups.rollback: Promotion mutations retain their existing recovery. The catalog fence is forward-only and remains until the W3f proposal authority replaces legacy callers.

groups.name: customer-self-service
groups.authMode: customer session plus service-role customer domain port
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Customer domain validates session ownership before applying subscription/account actions.
groups.idempotency: customer id, subscription id, action id, and recovery token where applicable
groups.rollback: Disable customer self-service flags and keep customer account read model available.

groups.name: customer-subscription-control-actor
groups.authMode: authenticated customer actor through the explicit node-postgres subscription-control adapter
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The actor wrappers derive the customer from auth.uid(), expose only the neutral snapshot/preview/apply bundle control rail, and grant no actor table DML.
groups.idempotency: subscription id, quote idempotency key, quote hash, expected revision and accepted event identity
groups.rollback: Disable node-postgres subscription-control composition; managed default composition and the fixed pause action remain available.

groups.name: customer-subscription-pause-actor
groups.authMode: authenticated customer actor through the explicit node-postgres pause adapter or exact parity harness
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The wrapper derives the customer from auth.uid(), exposes only pause, and delegates to the neutral lifecycle rail without actor table DML.
groups.idempotency: subscription id and caller-provided idempotency key under the lifecycle row lock
groups.rollback: Disable explicit node-postgres bundle selection; managed default composition remains unchanged.

groups.name: platform-and-tester-read-models
groups.authMode: service-role platform jobs or public read-only BFF
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Platform job ledger writes stay in platform; tester active count is read-only.
groups.idempotency: job run id or read-only aggregate
groups.rollback: Disable platform job runner or fall back to existing read-only aggregate.

groups.name: channels-order-ingest
groups.authMode: service-role only, through the channels ingest store port; there is no route and no schedule in this wave, so the only caller is the saga's own composition
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The channels domain owns the ingest ledger and the quarantine drawer, and is the only writer of channel-sourced commerce orders. Browser clients never reach these RPCs, and no other domain calls them: the payment-control and inventory rails are reached through their own owners' RPCs, not re-implemented here.
groups.idempotency: channel_order_ingests UNIQUE (channel_id, external_order_ref) is the saga identity; the order boundary additionally writes commerce_idempotency_keys under scope channels.order.create and is backstopped by the partial UNIQUE (source_channel_id, source_order_ref) on commerce_orders. inbound_provider_events UNIQUE (provider, provider_event_id) makes a redelivery a no-op, and sales_channel_quarantine UNIQUE (provider_event_id, vocabulary) keeps a repeated refusal one row.
groups.rollback: Nothing calls these RPCs until the entrypoint wave lands: the saga is a library with no route and no cron. Rolling back means not composing it. Existing rows are inert - the ledger and quarantine are read by nothing, and no storefront order path touches either.

groups.name: dunning-lifecycle-platform-rail
groups.authMode: the application's own role-free dunning-lifecycle connection lane; the public platform rail creates no service role and grants nothing to a browser principal
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The public platform rail owns the neutral dunning case, its queued notice, the reminder ledger and the scans over them. Every routine is invoker-rights with a fixed search path, and the retry ladder is an ARGUMENT the application computes rather than a schedule embedded here.
groups.idempotency: case idempotency key, the (case, notice kind, attempt) uniqueness of a queued notice, and the reminder ledger's (subscription, kind, day)
groups.rollback: Disable COMMERCE_DUNNING_EMAILS_ENABLED; the routines are reachable only from the direct composition's own lane and produce no customer-visible effect while off.

groups.name: communications-recipient-consent-platform-rail
groups.authMode: the application's own role-free dunning-lifecycle connection lane; no browser principal receives a grant on the public platform rail
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The public platform rail answers the pre-send question by recipient FINGERPRINT and reads the operator-wide control off the existing delivery-control row. It stores no recipient address and writes no decision row per send.
groups.idempotency: (recipient fingerprint, purpose) is the primary key; a repeated capture updates the recorded state in place
groups.rollback: Remove the recorded consent rows or re-enable the delivery control; both reads fail OPEN, so a missing row sends.

groups.name: customer-support-recovery
groups.authMode: service-role through the customer-support journey adapter
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Support verifies the operator and issues one idempotent recovery, subscription or email-correction command through the managed RPC boundary. The subscription command resolves the subscriber principal itself and delegates to the customer self-service chain; no caller supplies an authenticated user id.
groups.idempotency: operator-supplied idempotency key; the recovery command pairs it with an immutable caller fingerprint, the two operator command routines compute their own fingerprint from the command's fields so a caller cannot re-label a replay
groups.rollback: Disable customer recovery, subscription and email-correction commands; existing command and audit rows remain append-only.

groups.name: order-review-capability-platform-rail
groups.authMode: the direct application's private PostgreSQL lane after customer grant or platform-operator authorization; no browser database principal receives a grant
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Commerce owns the canonical review, one-time upload admission, exact-key media lifecycle, moderation, revocation and reconciliation. Customer and operator traffic reaches the routines only through mounted BFF/raw bindings, and object keys never cross the server boundary.
groups.idempotency: one review per order; command kind/key plus immutable fingerprint receipts; capability digest; fenced writer lease/state version; reconcile and cleanup receipts
groups.rollback: Remove the direct order-review binding or ORDER_REVIEW_MEDIA_ROOT; the hosted legacy review-token and feedback-event behavior remains on its managed adapter paths.

groups.name: acquisition-case-platform-rail
groups.authMode: the direct application enters the NOLOGIN platform_acquisition_runtime role for one transaction; operator list and lifecycle routes complete token and durable platform-operator authorization before opening this binding
groups.writerReaderPolicy: The Clients domain owns the tester_application acquisition case, private normalized contact correlation, opaque address reference, consent evidence, lifecycle, exact active count and minimal append-only audit. Browser principals receive no database grant; projections never expose contact values or keyed fingerprints.
groups.idempotency: submit and transition use scope plus caller idempotency key, a restart-stable installation-keyed command fingerprint, keyed normalized-email dedupe, advisory transaction locks, expected lifecycle version and one append-only receipt/audit
groups.rollback: Remove the direct acquisition binding; the managed tester/signup/status implementations remain selected by deployment-overlay and the durable acquisition ledger remains inert.

groups.name: partner-acquisition-platform-rail
groups.authMode: the direct application enters platform_acquisition_runtime for one transaction; operator list and lifecycle authorize the durable platform operator before opening the partner binding
groups.writerReaderPolicy: Partners owns partner_inquiry organization/contact facts and pipeline status inside the shared acquisition case authority. Browser principals receive no database grant; the neutral V1 projection exposes no provider or CRM identifier and direct submit requests no provider email.
groups.idempotency: submit and transition use distinct scope plus caller idempotency key, restart-stable installation-keyed command/contact fingerprints, advisory transaction locks, expected status version and one append-only receipt/audit
groups.rollback: Remove the direct partner-acquisition binding; managed B2B submit/list/status remain selected for managed bundles and the direct ledger remains inert.
